```{r}
# Define the MCDA variables, their labels, units, and direction
# Direction: "benefit" = higher value = higher priority for greening
#            "cost"    = lower value  = higher priority for greening
var_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~var,             ~label,                        ~unit,     ~direction,
  "lst",            "Land Surface Temperature",    "°C",      "benefit",
  "imd",            "Imperviousness Density",      "%",       "benefit",
  "dist_bs",        "Distance to Blue Space",      "m",       "benefit",
  "Lden",           "Noise Pollution",             "dB",      "benefit",
  "new_trafficvol", "Traffic Volume",              "count",   "benefit",
  "no2_avg_21",     "NO2 (annual mean 2021)",      "µg/m³",   "benefit",
  "perc_tree",      "Street Tree Cover",           "%",       "cost",
  "recreation_m2",  "Recreation Space",            "m²",      "cost"
)
# Extract only the MCDA variables as a plain data frame (drop geometry)
mcda_vars <- var_info$var
df <- data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(c("ID", "gid", mcda_vars)))
```

```{r}
desc_stats <- df %>%
  select(all_of(mcda_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid   = sum(!is.na(value)),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(value)),
    min       = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    p2        = quantile(value, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1        = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median    = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean      = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3        = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    p98       = quantile(value, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE),
    max       = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd        = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    skewness  = (mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) - median(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(var_info, by = c("variable" = "var")) %>%
  relocate(label, unit, .after = variable)

desc_stats %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Descriptive statistics of MCDA input variables") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) #"striped" — alternating row colors (grey/white) for readability, "hover" — highlights the row when you hover over it with the mouse, "condensed" — reduces padding for a more compact table. full_width = FALSE — table doesn't stretch to fill the whole page

```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(new_trafficvol = replace_na(new_trafficvol, 0))
library(ggcorrplot)

# Define variable sets
vars_full    <- c("lst", "imd", "dist_bs", "Lden", "new_trafficvol", "no2_avg_21", "perc_tree", "recreation_m2")
vars_no_rec  <- c("lst", "imd", "dist_bs", "Lden", "new_trafficvol", "no2_avg_21", "perc_tree")
vars_minimal <- c("lst", "imd", "dist_bs", "Lden", "new_trafficvol", "no2_avg_21")

# Labels for readable plots
labs <- c(lst = "LST", imd = "Imperviousness", dist_bs = "Dist. Blue Space",
          Lden = "Noise", new_trafficvol = "Traffic", no2_avg_21 = "NO2",
          perc_tree = "Tree Cover", recreation_m2 = "Recreation")

# Function to compute and plot
run_cor <- function(data, vars, title) {
  df_cor <- data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% drop_na()
  mat <- cor(df_cor, method = "spearman")
  rownames(mat) <- labs[rownames(mat)]
  colnames(mat) <- labs[colnames(mat)]
  
  ggcorrplot(mat, type = "lower", lab = TRUE, lab_size = 3.5,
             colors = c("#D85A30", "white", "#1D9E75"),
             title = title,
             ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
}

# Run all three
p1 <- run_cor(data, vars_full,    "Spearman: all 8 variables")
p2 <- run_cor(data, vars_no_rec,  "Spearman: without recreation")
p3 <- run_cor(data, vars_minimal, "Spearman: without recreation & tree cover")

p1 
p2
p3
```

```{r}
# Green space sufficiency: E2SFCA Gaussian (final choice, matches Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd)
library(arrow)

exposure_e2sfca <- read_parquet(
  here::here("analysis/exposure/final_metrics.parquet")
) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(unit_id = as.character(unit_id)) %>%
  select(unit_id, green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss, green_m2_e2sfca_per_person)

data$gid <- as.character(data$gid)
data <- data %>%
  left_join(exposure_e2sfca, by = c("gid" = "unit_id"))

cat("Matched:", sum(!is.na(data$green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss)), "out of", nrow(data), "\n")
summary(data$green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss)
```

```{r}
# Normalization functions
normalize_minmax <- function(x, lower = NULL, upper = NULL) {
  if (is.null(lower)) lower <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(upper)) upper <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x <- pmin(x, upper)
  x <- pmax(x, lower)
  (x - lower) / (upper - lower)
}

normalize_fuzzy <- function(x, onset, saturation) {
  out <- (x - onset) / (saturation - onset)
  out <- pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
  out
}

# All normalized to [0,1] where 1 = highest priority for greening
```


```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # Capped at p98, used as relative indicator of intra-urban 
    # thermal variation since no absolute health thresholds 
    # exist for satellite-derived LST
    norm_lst = normalize_minmax(lst,
                                lower = min(lst, na.rm = TRUE),
                                upper = quantile(lst, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    norm_imd = normalize_minmax(imd, lower = 0, upper = 100),
    
    norm_dist_bs = normalize_minmax(dist_bs,
                                     lower = 0,
                                     upper = quantile(dist_bs, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    norm_Lden = normalize_minmax(Lden,
                                  lower = min(Lden, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  upper = quantile(Lden, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Log transform reflects diminishing marginal health impact 
    # at higher volumes (Weber-Fechner, community severance).
    # Capped at p98: beyond 472 vehicles the difference in 
    # health and perception effects is negligible
    norm_traffic = {
      cap <- 472
      x <- pmin(new_trafficvol, cap)
      log(x + 1) / log(cap + 1)
    },
    
    norm_no2 = normalize_minmax(no2_avg_21,
                                 lower = min(no2_avg_21, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 upper = quantile(no2_avg_21, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Inverted: more trees = less priority. Capped at p98 (14.18%):
    # cells above are parks/golf, already captured by other variables
    norm_tree = 1 - normalize_minmax(perc_tree, lower = 0, upper = 14.18),
    
    # Inverted: less green per person = higher priority. Capped at p98; NAs
    # (unrouted cells, no population) replaced with 0 — neutral on this criterion.
    # Matches Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd's norm_green_exp exactly.
    norm_green_exp = replace_na(
      1 - normalize_minmax(green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss,
                           lower = 0,
                           upper = quantile(green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss,
                                            0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
      0)
  )

# Check
norm_vars <- c("norm_lst", "norm_imd", "norm_dist_bs", "norm_Lden",
               "norm_traffic", "norm_no2", "norm_tree", "norm_green_exp")

data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(norm_vars)) %>% summary()
```

----WEIGHTED LINEAR COMBINATION---
```{r}
raw_weights <- c(
  norm_tree       = 148.26,
  norm_imd        = 128.44,
  norm_traffic    = 116.33,
  norm_no2        = 115.41,
  norm_lst        = 96.70,
  norm_Lden       = 88.62,
  norm_green_exp  = 87.71,
  norm_dist_bs    = 29.72
)

# Rescale to sum to 1 (excluding overcrowding and recreation)
weights <- raw_weights / sum(raw_weights)
round(weights, 3)
```

```{r}
# Weighted priority score
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    priority_weighted = weights["norm_tree"]       * norm_tree +
                        weights["norm_imd"]        * norm_imd +
                        weights["norm_traffic"]    * norm_traffic +
                        weights["norm_no2"]        * norm_no2 +
                        weights["norm_lst"]        * norm_lst +
                        weights["norm_Lden"]       * norm_Lden +
                        weights["norm_green_exp"]  * norm_green_exp +
                        weights["norm_dist_bs"]    * norm_dist_bs
  )
 # Equal weights: just the mean
data <- data %>%
  mutate(priority_equal = rowMeans(across(all_of(norm_vars)), na.rm = TRUE))
```


```{r}
# Compare equal vs citizen weights
library(patchwork)

p1 <- ggplot(data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = priority_equal), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey90", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Equal weights") +
  theme_void()

p2 <- ggplot(data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = priority_weighted), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey90", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Citizen weights") +
  theme_void()

p1 + p2
```
```{r}
cor(data$priority_equal, data$priority_weighted, use = "complete.obs")

# Where do they actually differ?
data <- data %>%
  mutate(weight_diff = priority_weighted - priority_equal)

ggplot(data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = weight_diff), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Citizen - Equal") +
  labs(title = "Difference: citizen weights minus equal weights",
       subtitle = "Red = citizen weights give higher priority, blue = lower") +
  theme_void()
```
```{r}
# What's driving the difference? Map the biggest weight changes
# Blue space: dropped from 0.125 to 0.037
# Tree cover: rose from 0.125 to 0.183

ggplot(data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = norm_dist_bs), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Distance to blue space (the downweighted variable)") +
  theme_void()
```
